title: No overlinking: TRN-305 is a different case
description: Same symptoms on a 2024 TX-5000, but the cause is a missing VLAN on the new port. Tests that the knowledge is bound to the instance only and never to the class of old TX-3000 units.
subject: TRN-305 no traffic after SFP swap

incident.summary: No traffic on TRN-305 after an SFP swap

messages.text: Erkki, I'm at the harbour hut on TRN-305. New TX-5000, swapped the SFP, link UP, counters zero. Same as TRN-042?
The old bug is on the TX-3000s. This is a TX-5000 with newer firmware, so let's not assume. What does the port config say?
Checking... the new port is in default VLAN 1, the others are tagged with 120.
There it is. Service VLAN 120 is not tagged on that port. Set the port to trunk and tag VLAN 120.
Good. Only seen it on this one so far, so I would not call it a rule.

items.summary: On TRN-305, after the SFP swap the new port was in the default VLAN; tagging service VLAN 120 restored traffic.
items.diagnosis: service VLAN 120 not tagged on the new port
items.action: Set the port to trunk and tag VLAN 120.
